parameters.query:
SELECT id, url, name, expected_response, timeout_seconds, 
       failure_threshold, current_failure_count, priority,
       check_interval_minutes, expected_response_chars,
       http_method
FROM monitored_urls 
WHERE is_active = TRUE 
  AND (
    last_checked_at IS NULL OR 
    last_checked_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL check_interval_minutes MINUTE)
  )
ORDER BY FIELD(priority, 'critical', 'high', 'normal', 'low'), last_checked_at ASC
LIMIT 20

parameters.columns: url_id, status, response_time_ms, http_status_code, response_body_preview, response_headers, error_message, checked_at

parameters.query:
UPDATE monitored_urls 
SET 
  last_checked_at = NOW(),
  last_status = '{{ $json.status }}',
  current_failure_count = {{ $json.new_failure_count }},
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.url_id }}

SELECT 
    agm.notification_type, 
    agm.destination, 
    agm.member_name,
    ag.group_name,
    ag.id as group_id,
    uag.alert_on_down,
    uag.alert_on_up,
    uag.alert_on_timeout,
    uag.alert_on_error
FROM url_alert_groups uag
JOIN alert_groups ag ON uag.group_id = ag.id
JOIN alert_group_members agm ON ag.id = agm.group_id
WHERE uag.url_id = {{ $json.url_id }} 
  AND uag.is_active = TRUE
  AND ag.is_active = TRUE
  AND agm.is_active = TRUE
  AND (
    ('{{ $json.status }}' = 'down' AND uag.alert_on_down = TRUE) OR
    ('{{ $json.status }}' = 'up' AND uag.alert_on_up = TRUE) OR  
    ('{{ $json.status }}' = 'timeout' AND uag.alert_on_timeout = TRUE) OR
    ('{{ $json.status }}' = 'error' AND uag.alert_on_error = TRUE)
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM alert_history ah 
    WHERE ah.url_id = uag.url_id 
      AND ah.group_id = ag.id
      AND ah.notification_type = agm.notification_type
      AND ah.destination = agm.destination
      AND ah.sent_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 MINUTE)
  )

parameters.columns: url_id, group_id, notification_type, destination, alert_type, message, sent_at, success
